top.description: Top position coordinate on the canvas

left.description: Left position coordinate on the canvas

toUuid.description: Canvas anchor UUID for the incoming endpoint of the destination state on the designer. Type: string. Required. This is not the state ID; it is a visual port identifier used only by chartData.connectionDetails. Pattern: state name followed by a unique numeric suffix (for example, "On Hold1", "Closed1"). Each connection endpoint must use its own anchor UUID. Do not reuse the same UUID as both the incoming anchor (toUuid) and outgoing anchor (fromUuid) on the same state. Example: for Open -> On Hold -> Closed, use toUuid "On Hold1" on the first connection and fromUuid "On Hold2" (not "On Hold1") on the second connection.

transName.description: Name of the transition for the connection

isCommTrans.description: Indicates whether the connection is a common transition. Possible values: @true@ - connection is a common transition, @false@ - connection is a specific transition

fromUuid.description: Canvas anchor UUID for the outgoing endpoint of the source state on the designer. Type: string. Required. This is not the state ID; it is a visual port identifier used only by chartData.connectionDetails. Pattern: state name followed by a unique numeric suffix (for example, "Open0", "On Hold2"). Each connection endpoint must use its own anchor UUID. When a state has both incoming and outgoing connections, assign different suffixes for each port (for example, incoming toUuid "On Hold1" and outgoing fromUuid "On Hold2"). Reusing one anchor for both directions prevents the designer from rendering the second connection.

usedStates.description: States that share the common transition

isAuto.description: Indicates whether the transition is automatic. Possible values: @true@ - transition is automatic, @false@ - transition is manual

slaTime.description: SLA time configured for the state

lastModifiedStateName.description: Name of the last modified state

fromState.description: Logical source state name for this visual connection. Type: string. Required for blueprint draft create/update requests. Must exactly match a states[].name value and align with fromUuid (for example, fromState "On Hold" with fromUuid "On Hold2").

toState.description: Logical destination state name for this visual connection. Type: string. Required for blueprint draft create/update requests. Must exactly match a states[].name value and align with toUuid (for example, toState "Closed" with toUuid "Closed1").

connectionDetails.description: Visual connection wiring for the blueprint draft designer canvas. Type: array of connection objects. Required. Works together with connections and transitions to render lines in the UI. MCP rule: fromUuid and toUuid are per-port canvas anchors, not state IDs; assign unique anchors per endpoint. For a chain such as Open -> On Hold -> Closed, example anchors are fromUuid "Open0", toUuid "On Hold1", then fromUuid "On Hold2", toUuid "Closed1".
